strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ka a nenge sha ikyav i i lu eren tom a mi hegen la sha ikyav i Google i i dugh la (CRL) shi a nôngo sha ajiir kpishi zan zan a kar zuan a ikyav i i lu vough yô, shi a lu a kwagh u eren sha mi iyol na shi a hide a hii u eren tom u i yer ér Google la. Ka i er tom sha hanma tap cii shi i gba u a er tom a intanet (miniti 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox u a lu ken mzough la: ka a tôô keybox u a lu hen ijiir i koson akaa i gomoti (GitHub) la, a koso un hen /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Gba u a lu a intanet shi a tôô miniti 1-3. I er tom a mi shighe u smart fetch la a er tom ga shin shighe u i gema keybox la sha ave yô.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: ka a nenge sha akaa a a lu ken mzough u Remote Key Provisioning la, shi a nenge sha ikyav i tesen ér kwagh ngu eren la, shi a tese mlu u ikyagh ki tomough ki KmInstallKeybox la kpaa. Ka a gema kwagh môm ga — ka mlu u ikyagh ki tomough ki wang.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine nenge (u ôron tseegh): tese Widevine akav a tesen mlu u kwagh (L1/L3) a a lu ken dumpsys la, man mlu u DRM (IDM) key-file la, man akaa a a zough sha kwagh u mlu u ken iyol la. Ka a gema kwagh môm ga.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Kwagh u i nger ken takerada u RKP la: eren tom a takerada u /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh la. Ka a sôr akaa a a bende a ikyav i tesen ér kwagh ngu zan hemen la shighe u i lu eren tom ga yô. Hanma run cii ka i gber ikyav i mzehemen/mzehemen wang.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Mzough u RKP u sôron: eren tom a sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh u sôron. Ka a nenge sha akaa a taver shi a tôô shighe kpishi. Kwagh u a dugh ker la una due wang ken masejime.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: ka a sôr akaa a a lu ken Play Store man Google la (GMS+GSF) shi a hide a hii u eren tom a ikyagh ki tomough kira iyol i ki. Sha ci u ikyav i tesen ér kwagh ngu nahan tseegh — mayange bende a ufoto ou shin ufiim ou ga.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: ka a nenge mlu u ikyav i RKP i i lu sha ikyagh ki tomough la, shi a hide a sôr akaa a i nger sha mi la aluer gba u a er nahan yô. Ka i bende a kwagh u or u nan lu eren tom a mi la ga.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER sôron: sôron Google mzough u eren tom (SOTER) u a zough sha kwagh u ikyav i tesen ér kwagh ngu eren la. I er tom a mi sha ikyav mbigenev mbi mbi suur sha SOTER sha ityough ki Play Integrity yô.
strings.mdPifApply: • U er tom a PIF: u er tom a tahav mbu sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Ka i er tom a ikyav i i tsough la (i hen ijiir/i ken hemen) shi i hide i sôr akaa a i yer ér pif.prop/pif.json la. Kwagh u a dugh ker la tese wang ken takerada u ôron kwagh la.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: tese mlu u injin u i we la, man ikyav mbi eren tom a mi la (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), man ikyav mbi eren tom a mi la. Check tseegh — ka a gema kwagh môm ga.
strings.mdCanary: • Kwagh u i er ken tar u Canary yô: ka /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ka i tôô ikyav i Canary Engine i i sember duen la sha er ia zua sha ikyav i RKP i i gbe u a nger la yô (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • M-ban u injin: ka a nenge sha mlu u TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), man ufiim mba ken akwati u eren tom la (active vs or u eren tom a mi la), man ikyav i uwegh ku or u nan lu eren tom a mi la, man ikyav i target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP la. Ka i tese ikyav i diagnostic tseegh.

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
